method: Diagnostic oracle approximation: least-squares team strength plus common home effect fitted to observed margins; centered empirical game residuals with 1230/(1230-30) variance correction, 5000 independent resampled seasons on actual schedule. Team IDs used only to estimate diagnostic latent strengths, never simulation probability inputs. Fixed strengths/independent games assumed; oracle knows these strengths. Not an information-theoretic lower bound and no parameter-estimation uncertainty included.
sensitivity: Net floor approximately proportional to residual SD; +/-10% residual SD implies +/-10% net floor. Real schedules/availability and changing strength violate stationarity; observed one-season team means are not exact latent targets.
